objective: Review the Bazaar discovery metadata validation fix for Data Quality Profiler v0.1.0.
summary: Applied metadata-validation corrections to the Bazaar discovery extension per chatgpt handoff data-quality-profiler-bazaar-validation-fix-2026-08-18. The Bazaar declaration now passes the official validateDiscoveryExtension from @x402/extensions/bazaar with zero errors. Key changes: (1) Bazaar input example changed from descriptive string '{format: "json | csv — dataset format", records: "description"}' to a valid JSON-form request '{format: "json", records: [{id: 1}]}' that satisfies the oneOf schema's JSON alternative. (2) Added method: 'POST' to declareDiscoveryExtension config so the schema's required ['method'] is satisfied at build time — enrichDeclaration overwrites it from the transport context. (3) Added output.schema with type: 'object' and required: [schema_version, scoring_version, quality_score] for proper JSON Schema structure. (4) Added new test importing validateDiscoveryExtension and asserting .valid === true with zero errors. Tests: 59/59 pass (up from 58), deterministic across 2 runs. No profiler/scoring/canonicalization/payment changes.
